description: Get every shop that sells a product, with price, shipping cost and total, sorted from cheapest. `id` comes from buscar_productos. Prices are in euros. `envio_eur` null means the shop does not publish the shipping cost (not free); `precio_total_eur` is then null too. `bajada` is a real price drop recorded by SeeStocks in the last 7 days. `pvp_tienda_eur` is the recommended retail price declared by the shop, not verified by SeeStocks: it is not a price drop. `historial` is the history of the lowest price across shops: 90-day minimum and maximum, whether today is the 90-day low, the last change and recent prices; `precio_estable_90d` true means the price has not changed for 90 days or more. Use it to say whether now is a good time to buy. `url` opens the shop's product page.
name: ficha_producto
title: Compare prices of a product
